title: lonicera tatarica f. rosea
intro: Lonicera tatarica f. rosea, commonly known as Tatarian honeysuckle or rosea Tatarian honeysuckle, is a flowering plant species within the honeysuckle family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Lonicera tatarica f. rosea include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and relieving coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
